raw:
@q query
  select ?w
  where all
    match
      relation "win"
      role subject ?w
      role object "the tender for thermal rehabilitation of the four social housing blocks on Rozelor Street in the Tătărași neighbourhood"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "launch"
      role subject "Primăria Iași"
      role object "the tender for thermal rehabilitation of the four social housing blocks on Rozelor Street in the Tătărași neighbourhood"
      role time "spring"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
